entities.name: Venceslaus Ulricus Hammershaimb
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Venceslaus Ulricus Hammershaimb was a Faroese Lutheran minister who established the modern orthography of Faroese – the language of the Faroe Islands – based on the Icelandic language, which like Faroese, derives from western dialects of Old Norse.
